gaps.what: 30 Cliopatria shapes carry an 'unverified: page budget' note (17 wholly, verdict ok: 1492, 1497, 1564, 1588, 1673, 1702, 1721, 1734, 1744, 1757, 1763, 1778, 1780, 1796, 1799, 1800, 1803; 13 in part: 1502, 1526, 1547, 1572, 1629, 1632, 1645, 1683, 1706, 1709, 1718, 1738, 1762); the 1778 shape has 178 Bavarian cells and 4 Nicobar cells that no page explains

39 events at confidence 1 (shape-derived dates and regions), among them the 1487 found, the 1507 merge, the 1516 gain, the 1706 Spanish Netherlands occupation start, Silesia 1632 and 1642, the 1716 contest start, 1720 Sicily and the 1778-1779 Bavarian dispute

Lusatia 1620-1635: this dossier and bohemian-confederacy have Saxony receive it in July 1620 (Thirty Years' War page); electorate-of-saxony has a Saxon occupation for the emperor from September 1620 against habsburg-monarchy, pledged 1623, ceded 1636, and no event naming the rebels

Overlaps with the Spanish dossier (Low Countries and Franche-Comte 1516-1528 and 1556 onward) and with Cliopatria's Kingdom of Bohemia (ends 1528), Kingdom of Hungary (ends 1546) and Grand Duchy of Tuscany rows; the 1529-1555 correction adds the Bohemian crown lands and Royal Hungary on the assumption that no other dossier draws them
Rulers not listed; the Habsburg monarchy page names only selected rulers and the list page was not opened

Frontier and extent of the Confederacy's authority, Upper Austria's adhesion, and the surrender dates of Moravia and Silesia are not on the three pages opened; the Bohemian_Confederation article does not exist
No seat or capital, no frontier and no area on the single page opened; Transdanubia and Transylvania held by the rising are undated and not drawn; Treaty of Szatmar undated

problems: Page budget: the habsburg-monarchy dossier cites 15 pages (14 plus Rakoczi's War of Independence for the rebel counterpart); the two rebel dossiers cite 3 and 1 pages and open further pages (Bohemian Revolt, Frederick V, Rakoczi) outside the owned state's budget.

Cross-dossier conflict: electorate-of-saxony books Lusatia as a Saxon occupation from September 1620 against habsburg-monarchy; habsburg-monarchy and bohemian-confederacy book it as Saxony's from July 1620 (bohemian-confederacy loss to electorate-of-saxony has no matching gain there). A reviewer should choose one reading.

Month mismatch: bohemian-confederacy is founded on 31 July 1619 (Frederick V page) while the habsburg-monarchy loss to it is 19 August 1619 (Thirty Years' War page); the habsburg-monarchy contest with it starts in May 1618, before the Confederacy exists.

Counterparts 'Duchy of Mecklenburg', 'Duchy of Mantua' and 'Duchy of Parma and Piacenza' are written as names, not slugs, because no dossier or polities.csv row exists; replace by the slugs when the dossiers exist.
Transylvania is a vassal of the Habsburgs from 1699 with no vassal_end (lasts to 1805): 1 validator warning kept deliberately.
Rakoczi's rising: the confederated-estates-of-hungary dossier has an empty capitals list because the page names no seat; the validator accepts this.

The Habsburg monarchy page treats 1282-1918 as one state; Cliopatria splits it into Habsburg Monarchy (to 1805) and Austrian Empire (from 1806), and the house-of-habsburg and austrian-empire dossiers must keep one colour family.
